name: Into Your World
source:
Our guy got a no name game in the mail. When he played it, he end up in a mansion where 3 maids(big, middle, small) work for him. Now, waking up in the morning by his real world childhood girl, he attend class and can chase her or another school girl. Back home after school, he plays his maid game. If he manage to win a maid, she will be with him one way or another.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公在邮件里收到一款没有名字的游戏。启动后，他来到了一个宅邸，里面有三名女仆为他工作：大女仆、中女仆和小女仆。

与此同时，现实世界的青梅竹马每天早上叫醒他，他去学校上课，可以追求她或其他女同学。放学回家后，他继续玩女仆游戏。如果成功攻略某位女仆，她就会以某种方式来到他身边。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li’s Fun House[/url]]
